study.question: Does computing field-disagreement energy before event pooling retain useful second-moment information beyond the incumbent field-mean energy, and does any benefit require within-event content/context or within-bundle pairing under identical visible histories?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: the incumbent radius ||H mean(v)|| discards trace variance of event contrasts H v. r0010 energy_mean reproduced AUC 0.6200937865, versus energy_scalar 0.6192950690, presence_mean 0.6195929919 and presence_scalar 0.6193972634; the amplitude/direction interaction is +0.0006029890, single seed. These do not show event variance is predictive. Provisional mechanism: RMS radius sqrt(mean(||H v_event||^2)) supplies event-level dispersion while retaining the useful mean direction and fixed 48-coordinate bottleneck. Conditional empirical-product replacements discriminate marginal dispersion from within-event pairing. Counterevidence: r0007 paired content/context moments (0.6190555924) trailed factorized moments (0.6192439193), whereas r0006 observed action-age histogram (0.6191087654) beat its factorized control (0.6186617299). Earlier per-behavior attention also trailed DIN. Therefore neither richer granularity nor pairing is presumed beneficial.

inherited_components: Static field embeddings, padding/missing zero convention, action and log2-age embeddings and dormant allocated DIN attention module.
True target category/brand match groups; independent group content/context means; observed 4x4 action-age histograms; normalized log counts.

study.proposed_difference: For event v=(c,b,a,r), H maps four d-vectors to three orthonormal field contrasts. Parent A0=||H mean(v)||. Main Aobs=sqrt(mean(||H v||^2)); Aobs^2-A0^2 is trace variance of H v, not merely the existing field-mean energy. Abundle^2=Aobs^2+0.5 sum_g p_g [E((c+b) dot (a+r)|g)-mean(c+b|g) dot mean(a+r|g)], the exact expectation after independently pairing content and context bundles within true match groups. Afield^2=sum_g p_g ||H mu_g||^2+0.75 sum_j E Var(v_j|g), the exact four-field product expectation within groups. Product distributions include self combinations and are not derangements. All use the same global mean direction. Parent base, including observed action-age histograms, is untouched, so pairing is removed only from the appended scalar, not the full model. Every radius is computed in each forward; no trainable parameters are added. Negative cancellation roundoff in product energies is projected to zero with zero-safe square roots and measured diagnostics. Novelty outside this local contrast is unverified. Implementation validation: exact-rational synthetic checks established the stated expectation formulas and pairing-collision witnesses on 13,203 histories plus empty case; source/schema/allocation checks passed. This is analytic and implementation evidence, not a measured predictive mechanism result. Torch execution is deferred to the authorized host. No new open-memory file was written because this phase authorizes only model modules and proposal.json; this prospective study and the host-generated receipts preserve provenance without editing read-only evidence.
predictions: If the discarded event contrast variance helps within this recipe, event_energy should improve full-population validation AUC over pooled_parent without a material Logloss regression. A practical exploratory screen is delta AUC >=0.0002, not a significance threshold.
If content/context pairing specifically matters, event_energy should exceed bundle_product; otherwise equal or better bundle_product supports only marginal second moments or representation effects.

If within-bundle category/brand or action/age pairing matters after removing cross-bundle pairing, bundle_product should exceed field_product. This cannot distinguish the two within-bundle pair types.

At a fixed checkpoint the independent incumbent feature/logit error should be near float roundoff; all modes must be zero on empty history and padding invariant. Product radii should be nonnegative before projection up to roundoff.

Reversing complete action-age bundles within match groups must preserve the parent base and bundle_product/field_product amplitudes, while event_energy can change. Reversing brands within match groups must preserve the parent base and field_product amplitude; bundle_product may change. Whole-event order reversal must preserve all representations.
Report host parameter counts, training/wall/GPU allocation cost, memory, full inference throughput and batch p50/p95. Matching arithmetic is not an equal-compute or speedup claim.
falsifiers: Event RMS failing to improve over concurrent pooled_parent weakens this implementation of the variance hypothesis; it does not refute all event-level representations.

No observed advantage over bundle_product rejects support for a required cross-bundle pairing explanation in this scalar readout; no bundle advantage over field_product rejects support for within-bundle pairing here.

Parent reproduction mismatch, nonfinite host logits/gradients, appreciable negative product energies, or failures of declared invariances invalidate attribution until corrected; all failed costs remain charged.

A seed-42 improvement that reverses under paired final seeds, or whose uncertainty spans zero, remains preliminary. One adaptive validation win cannot establish a mechanism or external generalization.
